labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a new typed title argument (renderables), which is new behaviour in the public API.

body:
This is a feature request. Under Rich's feature policy, new features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is worked on, so please start the proposal there.

The `title` argument is annotated as `Union[str, Text]` in [rich/table.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py), so widening it is a public API change. Earlier reports on a related request are #4171 (closed, not planned) and #2266 (closed).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
